تقتحمين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَحِمِينَ (taqtaḥimīna) /taq.ta.ħi.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# تُقْتَحَمِينَ (tuqtaḥamīna) /tuq.ta.ħa.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
